Alban Lafont.note: Lafont's edge is command of the crowded space around goal. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Alban Lafont.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是掌控门前拥挤空间的能力。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Amad Diallo.note: Diallo is defined by creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Amad Diallo.noteZh: 他靠在防线重组前制造干净射门与同位置球员拉开差异。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。

Ange-Yoan Bonny.summary: Ange-Yoan Bonny is a Côte d'Ivoire centre-forward at Inter Milan who gives the national team hold-up play, box presence, and power running.
Ange-Yoan Bonny.note: Watch Bonny for making the next teammate's action easier. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. He absorbs contact and keeps the ball close enough to continue forward.
Ange-Yoan Bonny.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是让队友下一步处理更轻松。留意他如何稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。他也会承受身体接触后仍把球留在可继续推进的位置。

Bazoumana Toure.note: Touré stands out for carrying momentum through open midfield. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Bazoumana Toure.noteZh: 他的突出特点是带球穿过开放中场的推进力。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Christ Inao Oulai.note: Oulaï's signature is moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Christ Inao Oulai.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在用传球的力度和角度移动防线上。他会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Christopher Operi.note: Opéri's signature is delivering the ball without needing much space. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Christopher Operi.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在很小空间里也能送出传中的能力上。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Elye Wahi.note: Wahi stands out for starting his run while defenders are still watching the ball. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Elye Wahi.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在防守者仍盯着球时提前启动。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Emmanuel Agbadou.note: Agbadou's signature is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Emmanuel Agbadou.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢上。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Evan Ndicka.note: Ndicka stands out for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Evan Ndicka.noteZh: 他的突出特点是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Evann Guessand.note: Guessand's signature is making the next teammate's action easier. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Evann Guessand.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在让队友下一步处理更轻松上。他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Franck Kessie.note: Kessié is defined by creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Franck Kessie.noteZh: 他靠在防线重组前制造干净射门与同位置球员拉开差异。他会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Ghislain Konan.note: Watch Konan for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He gets close enough to block the delivery without diving in. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose.
Ghislain Konan.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。留意他如何靠近到能封堵传中，但不贸然出脚。他也会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。

Guela Doue.note: Watch Doué for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Guela Doue.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。留意他如何先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Ibrahim Sangare.note: Sangaré is defined by seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Ibrahim Sangare.noteZh: 他靠比防线早一步看到决定性的传球与同位置球员拉开差异。他会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Jean Michael Seri.note: Seri is defined by keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him.
Jean Michael Seri.noteZh: 他靠压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定与同位置球员拉开差异。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。

Mohamed Kone.note: Watch Koné for staying ready through long quiet spells. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Mohamed Kone.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在长时间无事可做后依然保持专注。留意他如何在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Nicolas Pepe.note: Pépé's signature is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Nicolas Pepe.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在防线重组前制造干净射门上。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Odilon Kossounou.note: Watch Kossounou for recovering position without panicking after the first line is broken. He changes position while keeping his priorities simple. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Odilon Kossounou.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是第一道防线被突破后仍能冷静回位。留意他如何改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Oumar Diakite.note: Diakité is defined by waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Oumar Diakite.noteZh: 他靠等防守者注意力转移后再启动与同位置球员拉开差异。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。

Ousmane Diomande.note: Diomande's edge is making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Ousmane Diomande.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择。他会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Parfait Guiagon.summary: Parfait Guiagon is a Côte d'Ivoire left winger at Charleroi who gives the national team tight-space dribbling, left-side creativity, and quick combinations.
Parfait Guiagon.note: Watch Guiagon for making purposeful movement away from the ball. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path.
Parfait Guiagon.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是用有目的的无球移动创造接应点。留意他如何主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。

Seko Fofana.note: Fofana is defined by creating a better angle for the next pass. He absorbs contact and keeps the ball close enough to continue forward. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Seko Fofana.noteZh: 他靠为下一脚传球制造更好的角度与同位置球员拉开差异。他会承受身体接触后仍把球留在可继续推进的位置。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Simon Adingra.note: Adingra stands out for making purposeful movement away from the ball. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Simon Adingra.noteZh: 他的突出特点是用有目的的无球移动创造接应点。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Wilfried Singo.note: Singo's edge is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He absorbs contact and keeps the ball close enough to continue forward. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Wilfried Singo.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。他会承受身体接触后仍把球留在可继续推进的位置。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Yahia Fofana.note: Fofana's edge is sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Yahia Fofana.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是提前站位后的快速反应。他会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。他也会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Yan Diomande.note: Watch Diomande for seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Yan Diomande.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。留意他如何等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。他也会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。
